news_risk: No adverse regulatory action, penalty or negative press found in the sources reachable during this check. Litigation profile is ordinary for a large industrial employer: labour/industrial-relations writs at the Hosur plant (2021 union writ, 2025 employer writs against the Assistant Commissioner of Labour), indirect-tax appeals at CESTAT Chennai (2019, 2026) and routine income-tax appeals at ITAT Bangalore. No criminal proceedings involving the company or its officers were found. Note: the web_search backend was unavailable during this session (connection refused) and the company's own site returned HTTP 403, so news coverage could not be swept systematically — absence of negative news here is a limitation of coverage, not a positive finding.
rf_supply: No evidence found. Searches on Indian Kanoon for WEG Industries / WEG Equipamentos together with Russia, Belarus or Kazakhstan returned no matching results. No public record of supplies to Russia or the CIS was located. Note: the parent group, WEG Equipamentos Eletricos S.A. (Brazil), is a global motor manufacturer with its own export footprint; group-level trade with Russia/CIS was not verified in this check and should not be attributed to the Indian entity without documentation.
note: Sanctions: no match found for the Indian entity on the OFAC SDN/Non-SDN consolidated list (list version dated 23.11.2026, retrieved from sanctionslistservice.ofac.treas.gov). UN, EU, UK and BIS Entity List screens were not directly queryable in this session — those remain unverified and should be re-run before onboarding. Per project rules, sanctions/court exposure is not a rejection ground; recorded neutrally as 'есть сложности' only in the sense of ordinary commercial litigation.
